latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the official Obsidian CLI integration.

- Enables full command-line access to Obsidian vaults (requires Obsidian 1.12+ and Catalyst license).
- Supports note management, file operations, search, content editing, properties, links, and task management from the terminal.
- Includes plugin, theme, and snippet management commands.
- Features advanced tools: workspace, sync, backup/restore, developer/debug utilities.
- Interactive TUI mode, autocomplete, and support for working with multiple vaults.
